summary: Master M&A and Post-Merger Integration with hands-on PMI playbooks, Day 1 planning, and synergy tracking. 5-day intermediate course for M&A managers and integra
lede: Post-acquisition management training covers planning and coordinating the integration of organizations after a deal. For corporate development, operations, and advisory professionals, it addresses practical execution tasks from readiness through integration closure. Participants practise drafting Day 1 plans and integration office charters, mapping functional workstreams, and tracking synergies with dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead, execute, or support M&A and post-merger integration across corporate development, functional operations, and advisory roles. It is ideal for intermediate-level practitioners with 2-5 years of M&A exposure who need structured PMI execution skills. As a professional, you will benefit by: M&A Manager:

prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of M&A concepts (valuation, due diligence, deal lifecycle). No coding required. Pre-course prep: Review a sample M&A case and bring your organization's integration challenges for workshop use. Tools: All templates, playbooks, and dashboards provided—no software pre-install needed.
